narr: Isolated flash flooding was observed across portions of Grand Forks County.
ev: Overland flooding developed across central and northern portions of Hegland Township, with flood waters washing over farmyards and roadways in route to smaller coulees and into the Turtle River.
Increased flooding developing in Hegland Township. Roads washing over in several locations and barricades going up.
Report and video of water flowing over and washing out a county road. Posted via social media.
lsr: VIDEO OF FLOWING WATER OVER HIGHWAY AND ACTIVELY WASHING OUT COUNTY ROAD.
ROADS WASHED OUT AND A FEW ROADS BARRICADED. FIELDS FULL OF WATER AND DITCHES HALF FILLED IN SOME SPOTS.
